sentence: The interactive end of the spectrum is more measured: IRIS puts a human in the loop over a three-agent ideation pipeline with Monte Carlo tree search, and reports that user interaction raised hypothesis scores by 0.5 points and ELO by 12 at depth 3 — but on a user study of 8 researchers (10 cases), with the gain measured by an LLM judge the authors themselves show correlates only moderately with human rankings (r=0.60) [cited].
ref: Aniketh Garikaparthi, et al. IRIS: Interactive Research Ideation System for Accelerating Scientific Discovery. arXiv preprint, 2025. https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.16728

sentence: Applying a conservative sample-size framework to externally validated radiomics models in first-quartile journals (2023–2025), one study found that of 64 assessed full texts, 16 (25%) could not even be assessed because feature counts were not reported; among the 28 assessable models the median deficit was 195.5 training instances, only 3 (10.7%) met stability criteria, and the median events-per-predictor deficit was 5.8 [cited].
ref: Burak Kocak, et al. Externally validated yet undertrained: sample size deficits in machine learning-based radiomics. European Radiology, 2026. https://doi.org/10.1007/s00330-026-12543-2

sentence: VDocRAG attacks the training rather than the architecture, adding two self-supervised objectives (retrieval-contrastive and token-generation with an attention mask that forces OCR content through the pooled `<EOS>` vector) and shows that the retrieval-specific pretraining matters: removing it costs 1.4–1.8 nDCG@5, and swapping the LVLM for CLIP encoders collapses SlideVQA retrieval from 77.3 to 43.7 [cited].
ref: Ryota Tanaka, et al. VDocRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Visually-Rich Documents. Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, 2025. https://doi.org/10.48550/arxiv.2504.09795

sentence: The same study disputes the original GraphRAG result directly, attributing the discrepancy to evaluation methodology — reference-free LLM-as-judge has strong position bias — and shows that under ROUGE-style reference metrics community GraphRAG's global search generally loses to RAG on query-based summarization, including a ROUGE-2 of 3.23 against RAG's 6.32 on QMSum [cited].

sentence: DistServe's motivating measurement is the cleanest statement of the opportunity: on one A100 with OPT-13B, colocated goodput is ~1.6 requests/s, prefill-only is 5.6 and decode-only 10, so splitting 2 prefill + 1 decode GPUs yields 10 rps, or 2.1× per GPU [cited].
